cached_summary.text: In Western Uusimaa only 46% of people aged 75 and over start treatment within the 6-week target, against 64% across the county
About 12% of this group start late because they miss the first visit, losing about 14 days each
Nearly half of the delayed first visits (46%) were never confirmed
Phone reminders cut missed appointments by 43% in one Danish hospital, but even with no missed visits at all this group would reach only 58%
